purpose: Official operating-scope research and no-shrink reconciliation against the supplied 74-row Navier proposal baseline. No repository edits or partner-facing claims.

rules: Existing 74-row footprint is the no-shrink baseline.
Official country support may inherit only existing Atlas hierarchy/geometry under the 80:20 rule.
Official city evidence strengthens the anchor only; it is not route evidence.
No route, demand, fare, fleet, revenue or economics claims are made.
A route-count ceiling is inventory context, never an approval.
methodology.source_priority: Official inDrive help, corporate, country and city pages; no download-only inference used.

count_caveats: The official help page says approximately 48 countries but enumerates 49 country names; the corporate page says 48. Individual named-country support is retained, while the aggregate discrepancy is source_cleanup_needed.

The supplied current CLUSTERS registry contains 102 member_city_ids across the 22 reconciled clusters (86 marked members_present), while the supplied plan says 101 registered cities. This one-city snapshot discrepancy requires registry/route receipt reconciliation before implementation.
The 2,382 route figure comes from the supplied planning document, not from a supplied ROUTES registry in this task. It is a candidate ceiling only.

Brazil.verdict: approve country-supported inheritance candidate for the existing Brazil Atlas cluster; Rio de Janeiro and Florianópolis are exact city-supported; Angra dos Reis/Ilha Grande is country-supported only.
Brazil.evidence_tier: city_supported for Rio/Florianópolis; country_supported for Angra/Ilha Grande
Brazil.route_disclaimer: No marine route or economics approval is implied.

Egypt.verdict: preserve and approve Egypt inheritance; Cairo, Hurghada and Sharm El Sheikh are exact city-supported. Cairo remains distribution context because city ride-hail evidence is not marine-route evidence.
Egypt.route_disclaimer: No Cairo marine route is established by these sources.

unresolved_blockers: Official inDrive sources disagree internally on aggregate scope: the help roster has 49 names but says approximately 48 countries; the corporate page says 48.
CLUSTERS current snapshot yields 102 member_city_ids / 86 members_present across the 22 clusters, versus 101 registered cities in the supplied plan.
No ROUTES registry was supplied, so the 2,382 candidate route ceiling and the Brazil/Egypt route counts were not independently recomputed.

Several retained baseline keys require alias cleanup rather than exact CLUSTERS member matches: al-hoceima→al-hoceima-morocco, casablanca→casablanca-morocco, tangier→tangier-morocco, and palawan-philippines__el-nido-bacuit-bay→palawan-philippines.

Exact city-level operation was intentionally targeted only where it changes the decision (Brazil, Egypt, plus cities exposed by the supplied Mexico official page); remaining display candidates rely on valid country-level 80:20 inheritance.
Seal/render identity, hidden/quarantined-route exclusion and visual QA remain pending; research did not modify proposal or repository files.
